origins.section: Catch-or-Declare Is a Compiler Rule; at Run Time Any Method Can Throw a Checked Exception
Adding a Checked Exception Breaks Every Caller's Source; Adding an Unchecked One Breaks None
A Throwable Is Checked Unless It Is a RuntimeException or an Error
Make It Checked When the Caller Can Act on It, Unchecked When It Means a Bug

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-stale-plugin-host: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stale-plugin-host: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-stale-plugin-host: Page shows the same setup: NightlyReport compiled against 1.x, run with the 2.0 jar; the original checked exception leaves main. 'The call linked, and a checked exception left main, which declares none. The JVM links a call by name and descriptor, and the descriptor holds no exceptions.' 'The throws clause sits in an Exceptions attribute that javac reads and the JVM doesn't check.' 'The service caught RuntimeException, which this exception isn't.'
recorded.prompt:q-exporter-interface: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-exporter-interface: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-exporter-interface: 'On an interface, adding throws IOException to a method breaks code that calls through the interface, but not the implementations, since an implementation may throw less than the interface declares.' Reference row: 'calls through the interface fail; implementations compile'.
recorded.prompt:q-shutdown-signal: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shutdown-signal: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-shutdown-signal: Summary: 'A class extending Throwable directly is checked, and catch (Exception e) doesn't catch it.' Output: 'escaped catch (Exception): CatchAll$Abort: workflow aborted by operator'.
recorded.prompt:q-bundled-template: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-bundled-template: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-bundled-template: By analogy: 'A URL that is a constant in our code fails only if we mistyped it, and the caller can do nothing at run time but crash. URI.create's javadoc names that case: "URI constants declared within a program", where a failure "would be considered a programming error".' Summary: 'unchecked for a bug. The same failure can be either, depending on where the input comes from.'
